summary: Korro Bio, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 announcing a submission to the Australian Alfred Health Human Ethics Committee to initiate a first-in-human Phase 1/2 clinical trial for KRRO-121, a GalNAc-conjugated RNA editing oligonucleotide for hyperammonemia in patients with Urea Cycle Disorders. The trial aims to evaluate safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, and effects in healthy volunteers and UCD participants. This is a routine clinical development update, not a special-situation corporate event, with no deal terms or transaction mechanics.
